$comment: NBA 2K27 BADGE TOKENS.
In 2K27 badges are no longer granted automatically when you hit an attribute threshold. Meeting
the threshold makes a badge tier ELIGIBLE; you then have to SPEND BADGE TOKENS to equip it, into
a limited number of badge slots. Tokens are earned per discipline by investing in that
discipline's attributes — raising Three-Point earns shooting tokens, and a single point can be
worth an extra token.
This makes the optimizer a two-budget problem: build points buy attributes, and attributes earn
tokens that buy badges. An attribute threshold you cannot afford to cash in is not worth chasing.
WHAT IS VERIFIED: that the mechanic exists, that tokens are per-discipline, that they scale with
attribute investment in that discipline, that badges must be bought rather than granted, that
there are limited slots, and that cap breakers do NOT grant extra tokens.
WHAT IS NOT VERIFIED: the exact token-earning formula, the exact slot counts per discipline, and
whether upgrading a badge pays the difference between tiers or the full new tier price. All the
numbers below are placeholders. Enter your real in-game numbers via the UI (they override this
file per-request) or edit `manualTokens` here.

verification.source: NBA 2K27 badge cost charts (token costs per tier) + community builder coverage of the token mechanic.
verification.notes: Mechanic confirmed; every quantity below is a placeholder.

'absolute' = equipping Gold costs the full Gold price. 'incremental' = you pay Gold minus what you already paid for Silver. The charts show a per-tier price but not which of these it means. 'absolute' is the more conservative reading.

verification.source: 20 starting badge slots across six disciplines is reported by 2K27 builder coverage.
verification.notes: The TOTAL of 20 is sourced. The per-discipline SPLIT below is invented and sums to 20. Bonus Slots earned through progression are not modelled.

$comment: mode 'linear-by-investment': tokens = floor( sum over that discipline's attributes of
max(0, rating - freeBelow) / pointsPerToken ), capped at maxPerDiscipline.
mode 'table': use `table` below — an exact list of { attribute, rating } ratings that each
grant one token. Use this once the real breakpoints are known; it is what the game actually
does ('sometimes just one point provides an additional badge token').
mode 'manual': ignore attributes entirely and use `manualTokens`.

verification.notes: Formula and constants are invented. Only the direction (more investment -> more tokens) is sourced. Calibrated so that a committed build earns enough tokens for BADGE SLOTS to be the binding constraint rather than tokens — which is what '20 badge slots' being the headline number implies. If real numbers show tokens are the tighter limit, lower pointsPerToken.

manualTokens.$comment: Set any of these to a number to override the computed token pool for that discipline. null = compute it. The UI exposes these as inputs so you can type your real in-game values.

capBreakersGrantTokensVerification.source: 2K27 builder coverage: 'applying cap breakers does not provide additional badge tokens'.
